notes.title: Game Award Nomination
notes.content:
Awesome news! - Trans Agent X has been nominated for "best newcomer" at the [url=https://virke.no/konferanser/spillprisen/]"Spillprisen" Awards[/url].

notes.title: Releasing my 3rd game on Steam!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786500/Relationship_Anarchy

[i]Investigate procedurally generated hidden relationships in a casual mystery game. Explore, find clues, deduce, infer, solve the puzzle, and unravel the true meaning.[/i]

I've been developing this game these past nine months, and I've finally managed to create a coming-soon steam page.

Wishlist if it looks like your cup of tea? : )

notes.title: Minor bugfixes
notes.content:
Just some minor bug fixes.

Bugfix
[list]
[*] The boss portal in level 3 will now always trigger the next level transition
[*] Fixed some spelling errors in norwegian
[*] The menu now has an exit lock of one second, preventing an accidentally rapid double-tap exit out of the game
[*] The last intro screen's delay before starting level 1 was raised from one second to two seconds
[/list]
